newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Compared Thursday close, slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Trade slow.
Demand and seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 1200 lbs ld 70.00. Heifers - mostly Choice 2-4 1150 lbs ld 73.00.

Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Thursday close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales Holsteins - (grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125-1200 lbs few 113.50-114.00.
